President Donald Trump said U.S. and Iranian officials met Tuesday, shortly after he threatened in his address to the U.N. General Assembly that he may “annihilate” the Islamic Republic if a deal isn’t reached soon to end nearly seven-month
Trump told reporters about the meeting but offered few details about the talks.
“When he’s standing before the U.N. today and saying that, you know, his decision is whether to annihilate Iran — who talks like that?” said Kaine, the Democrat from Virginia.
